entries.title: Pre-Action Validation Gate
entries.code_note: Built in both languages: one gateway in ToolRuntime that the agent cannot skip, for any tool that declares a `world` block (today `fs.write`). It checks authorization, current approval, authoritative state, preconditions and version, runs the action under a version-guarded lock, reads the result back instead of trusting the acknowledgment, fails closed when state cannot be read, and resolves a timeout from state before any retry. Remaining: only `fs.write` declares a world block, so other consequential tools (shell commands, external calls) are not gated; the guard is a process-local lock plus a re-read, not a storage-level conditional write, so it does not protect against a second worker; and nothing yet emits `approval.revoked`.
